title: Phive Text Scroll Animation
description: Scroll-driven sequence of pinned full-screen sections where giant uppercase words stretch open vertically (scaleY driven by each ScrollTrigger's scrub progress) and collapse as they leave; the final word scales up 10x while its dark backdrop fades to reveal a background image, then a SplitText headline reveals word-by-word.

images.desc: dark crowd under red and blue stage smoke at a late-night electronic set, revealed behind the final scaled-up word once its dark overlay fades out
images.role: background image of the third pinned section (.sticky-text-3 .bg-img)

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para secciones de texto grande que se estiran y colapsan al hacer scroll, con palabras gigantes tipo statement y un reveal final sobre imagen.
aliases: texto que se estira al scroll

motion.title: Phive Text Scroll Animation

motion.motion_signature: Pure linear scrub (no eases, no durations): each of three pinned sections stretches its headline on scaleY from 0 up to a measured sectionHeight/textHeight ratio on approach, then back to 0 while pinned; the third pinned section additionally zooms its text panel scale3d 1→10 over the first 75% of a 400vh pin, cross-fades the panel background alpha (0.25→0.5) and its opacity (0.5→0.75) to zero, and reveals the header word-by-word by index threshold over 0.75→0.95. Smoothing comes only from scrub:1 and Lenis inertia.
